season.evidence: Searched: SummitPost says climbable in all but winter, access via Harts Pass road; stored text already puts the start at about July 1 when the road and Fred/Rolo passes clear. Ascents peak Jul-Sep (120 of 149); one 29 June ascent still had rotten snow on the pass. Keeps Jul-Sep.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged South Slopes and SE Ridge, Class 3, summited 2024-06-29 (within a month of season), summit pin within 8 m, but track start/end are 447 m from our Slate Pass pin (a different parking spot at the road end). Fails the 300 m rule; I could not confirm a trailhead coordinate from a fetched page (WTA URL 404, Nominatim empty), so no pin move proposed. Best candidate if the owner accepts the start offset.
Four-day multi-peak slam (Osceola, Carru, Lago, Ptarmigan, Lost, Blackcap); not a single Carru route.
Starts from Lake Doris camp (11.6 km from pin); no route name.
No route name, start 815 m from pin.

facts.text: In mid-July the Pasayten River must be forded on the way in, and the Eureka Creek trail has some blowdown.
Fill water bottles well before the 7,100-ft meadow below the south slopes; in mid-July it offered only a thin trickle.
Pencil for the summit register (it has been found without one, Aug-Sep)
In late August one party left the Eureka Creek trail near 5,950 ft and climbed open, lightly forested slopes, partly on a climbers path, to about 7,300 ft before turning toward the summit.
In late June the lower descent toward the river from the col was brushy, worst at the very bottom, and the upper scree allowed quick boot-skiing that avoids the Class 3 bits.

notes: Our Slate Pass trailhead pin is matched by one Aug 2025 track (62 m), while a June 2024 track began 447 m west at what looks like another parking spot; pin not changed.
